items.text: “Thatha umfowenu u-Aroni namadodana akhe kanye naye kubantwana bakwa-Israyeli ukuba bangikhonze esikhundleni sobupristi, o-Aroni, noNadabi, no-Abihu, no-Eleyazare, no-Itamari, amadodana ka-Aroni.
Kumelwe wenzele u-Aroni umfowenu izambatho ezingcwele, zibe zenkazimulo nezomhlobiso.
Ukhulume nabo bonke abahlakaniphile ngenhliziyo, engibagcwalisile ngomoya wokuhlakanipha, ukuba benze izingubo zika-Aroni zokumngcwelisa, ukuze angikhonze njengobupristi.

Futhi lezi yizingubo abayozenza; isihlangu sesifuba, nendwangu yamahlombe, nejazi, nejazi elelukiweyo, nesigqoko, nebhande; futhi kumelwe benzele umfowenu u-Aroni namadodana akhe izingubo ezingcwele, ukuze angikhonze njengompristi.
Bayakuthatha igolide, nokububende, nokububende, nokubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo;
Bazakwenza ingubo yamahlombe ngegolide, nokububende, nokubomvu, nokubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo lemicu ephothiweyo, umsebenzi wengcweti.
Kumelwe ibe nezizinda ezimbili zamahlombe zihlanganiswe emaceleni ayo omabili; futhi kanjalo izohlanganiswa.
Ibhande le-efodi eliphezu kwayo liyakuba kulo njengomsebenzi wayo; negolide, nokububende, nokububende, nokubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo lemicu ephothiweyo.
Kumelwe uthathe amatshe amabili eshohamu uqophe kuwo amagama abantwana bakwa-Israyeli.
Amagama ayisithupha awo etsheni linye, namagama ayisithupha aseleyo kwelinye itshe ngokokuzalwa kwawo.
Njengomsebenzi womqophi wamatshe, njengokuqoshwa kophawu, uyakuqopha amatshe omabili ngamagama abantwana bakwa-Israyeli;

Kumelwe ubeke amatshe amabili emahlombe endwangu yamahlombe abe amatshe esikhumbuzo kubantwana bakwa-Israyeli; u-Aroni kumelwe athwale amagama abo phambi kukaJehova emahlombe akhe omabili abe yisikhumbuzo.
Kumelwe wenze amabhokisi ngegolide;
namaketanga amabili egolide elicwengekileyo ekugcineni; wowenza umsebenzi osongiweyo, ubophe amaketanga ecaleni.
Kumelwe wenze umphongolo wokwahlulela ngomsebenzi wobuqili; ulenze njengomsebenzi we-efodi; ulenze ngegolide, lokuyibubende, lokuyibubende, lokubomvu, lelineni elicolekileyo lemicu ephothiweyo.
Kumelwe liphindwe kabili; ubude balo bube njengokudalulwa kweminwe, ububanzi bube ngokweminwe yesandla.
Ufake kuwo amatshe, izinhla ezine zamatshe; kufanele kube umugqa wokuqala.
Uhlu lwesibili kumelwe lube nesimaragidu, isafire nedayimane.
Uhla lwesithathu lube yihakiki, ne-agathe, ne-amethiste;
uhla lwesine lube nombala omuhle, neshohamu, nejaspi; kumelwe ahusheshwe ngegolide emabhokisini azo.
Amatshe ayakuba njengamagama abantwana bakwa-Israyeli, ishumi nambili ngokwamagama abo, njengokuqoshwa kophawu; kube yileso naleso negama laso ngokwezizwe eziyishumi nambili.
Uyakwenza esihlangwini sesifuba amaketanga emiphethweni yegolide elicwengekileyo, umsebenzi osontiweyo.
Kumelwe wenze amasongo amabili egolide esihlangwini sesifuba, uwafake amasongo amabili emikhawulweni yomibili yesihlangu sesifuba.
Kumelwe ufake amaketanga amabili egolide emasongweni amabili asemaceleni esihlangu sesifuba.
Kumelwe ubophe izihloko ezimbili zamaketango amabili emabhokisini amabili, uwabophe ezizingeni zamahlombe zendwangu yamahlombe phambi kwawo.
Wenze amasongo amabili egolide, uwabophe emaceleni omabili esihlangu sesifuba, emphethweni waso ongaphakathi kwe-efodi.
Wenze amanye amasongo amabili egolide, uwafake ezinhlangothini zombili ze-efodi, phansi, maqondana nesinye isihlanganisi sayo, phezu kwe-efodi.

Kumelwe babophe isihlangu sesifuba emasongweni aso emasongweni endwangu yasehlombe ngentambo ebubende, ukuze sibe ngaphezu kwebhande lasehlombe lendwangu yasehlombe, futhi isihlangu sesifuba singahlukani nendwangu yasehlombe.
U-Aroni kumelwe athwale amagama abantwana bakwa-Israyeli esihlangwini sesifuba sokwahlulela phezu kwenhliziyo yakhe lapho engena endaweni engcwele ukuba akhumbule njalo phambi kukaJehova.
Kumelwe ufake i-Urimi neThumimi esihlangwini sesifuba sokwahlulela; ziyakuba senhliziyweni ka-Aroni lapho ehamba phambi kukaJehova;
Wenze ingubo yamahlombe yonke ngokunsomi.
Kumelwe kube nembobo phezulu kwawo, phakathi kwawo; kumelwe ibe nesibopho sokwelukiweyo nxazonke zembobo, njengembobo ye-habergeon, ukuze ingadabuki.
Phansi komphetho walo kumelwe wenze izivunulo ngokububende nangokububende nangokubomvu emiphethweni yawo; nezinsimbi zegolide phakathi kwazo nxazonke;
Insimbi yegolide nejazi lesiliva, insimbi yegolide nejazi legolide emiphethweni yejazi nxazonke.
U-Aroni azigqokise, ukuze akhonze, izwi lakhe lizwakale lapho engena endaweni engcwele phambi kukaJehova, nalapho ephuma, ukuze angafi.
Kumelwe wenze ungcwecwe wegolide elihlanzekileyo, uqophe kuwo njengokuqoshwa kophawu ukuthi: INGCWELE KUJEHOVA.
Kumelwe ulifake entanjeni ebubende, ibe phezu kweqhiye; phambi kwesigqoko kufanele kube.

Kumelwe ibe sebunzini lika-Aroni, ukuze u-Aroni athwale ububi bezinto ezingcwele abantwana bakwa-Israyeli abayozingcwelisa kuzo zonke izipho zabo ezingcwele; njalo izakuba sebunzini lakhe, ukuze bamukeleke phambi kweNkosi.
Ufekethise ingubo yangaphezulu ngelineni elicolekileyo, wenze isigqoko ngelineni elicolekileyo, wenze nebhande lokuthunga.
Wowenzela amadodana ka-Aroni izigqoko, uwenzele amabhande, uwenzele izigqoko, ezenkazimulo nezobukhazikhazi.
Uyakugqokisa u-Aroni umfowenu namadodana akhe kanye naye; ngibagcobe, ngibangcwelise, ngibangcwelise, ukuze bangikhonze njengabapristi.
Kumelwe ubenzele amabhulukwe elineni ukuze bamboze ihlazo labo; kusukela okhalweni kuze kufike okhalweni bayofinyelela.

U-Aroni namadodana akhe kumelwe bembathe lapho bengena etendeni lokuhlangana, noma lapho beza e-altare ukuze bakhonze endlini engcwele; ukuze bangathwali ububi futhi bafe; kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade kuye nasezizukulwaneni zakhe emva kwakhe.
